title: Introducing the Paragon Skill
summary: Build integrations faster than ever with Paragon's infrastructure and your coding agents. The Paragon Skill works alongside your coding agent of choice to give it context on how to build production-grade integrations with Paragon; this means no API maintenance, reliable infrastructure, and shipping integrations for your users in weeks, not months.
